title: Quel temps fera-t-il à Paris et ses environs le dimanche 24 août 2025 ?
content: According to the Ouest France weather report, the day of Sunday, 24 August 2025 in Paris and its surroundings will be largely clear with temperatures rising from 16 °C in the early morning to a high of about 26 °C by mid‑afternoon, then falling to 21 °C by midnight. The forecast states, 'Ce dimanche 24 août 2025 sera marqué par une température avoisinant 22 degrés et un ciel essentiellement dégagé.' and 'Il n'y aura pas de précipitation pendant la journée.' Wind will come from the north‑east at about 15 km/h, as the report notes, 'Le vent oscillera aux alentours de 15 km/h, et il sera en provenance du Nord-Est,' with gusts that could reach 45 km/h. The sky will shift from clear to cloudy in the afternoon, becoming fully cloud‑covered around 21 h, and the temperature will drop to 18 °C between midnight and 4 h, 'Le thermomètre diminuera jusqu'à 21 °C aux alentours de minuit.' The report also warns that 'Les rafales pourront franchir les 40 km/h.' The next day, 25 August, is expected to be even warmer, with an average of 25 °C and a maximum of 30 °C between 16 h and 19 h, as stated, 'Demain, les températures seront très élevées pour un mois d'août : elles seront de 25 °C en moyenne, avec un maximum de 30 °C atteint de 16 h à 19 h.' The weather will remain generally clear. The forecast is provided by Ouest France and is based on the Weather'n'co partnership.

title: Météo : 2025, le troisième été le plus chaud de l'histoire en Tarn-et-Garonne après 2022 et 2003
content: The meteorological assessment of the 2025 summer in Tarn‑et‑Garonne, covering 1 June to 31 August, shows that it was the third hottest on record for the region.  The average maximum temperature reached 29.7 °C, with the peak daily maximum on 11 August recorded at 42 °C – the third highest ever measured in the commune.  In Montauban the same day the thermometer read 41.8 °C, while in Caylus it reached 40.7 °C.  The 2023 summer, which also featured a heatwave, had a comparable average maximum of 29.7 °C.  The two previous record summers were 2022 (32 °C) and 2003 (31.9 °C), as noted by the MétéoFrance technician: 'Seules les années 2022 avec 32°C et 2003 avec 31,9°C sont au-dessus depuis le début de nos relevés à Montauban, en 1963. Il y a malgré tout une énorme différence avec ces deux valeurs-là'.  Minimum temperatures followed a similar pattern, with 2025’s average low of 17.1 °C ranking just below 2003 (18.5 °C), 2022 (17.4 °C) and 2023 (17.2 °C).  July experienced a severe drought, with only 12 mm of rainfall recorded in Montauban compared to a 60‑year average of 47 mm, according to Valéry Moutot: 'Pour la station de Montauban, on a ainsi relevé 12 mm de précipitations seulement, contre une moyenne de 47 mm sur les 60 dernières années'.  June 2025 received 55 mm, slightly below the 68 mm average, while August saw 68 mm, surpassing the 55 mm average.  Moutot cautioned against generalising these figures across the department: 'Il est néanmoins très dangereux, sur cette donnée, d'extrapoler avec l'ensemble du département, altère le météorologiste'.  Overall, the 2025 summer was described as 'bien ensoleillé' and its insolation ranked 12th among the last 35 years.

title: Météo. Après des jours de chaleurs, une baisse des températures annoncée à Toulouse et en Occitanie
content: After a week of scorching heat in Toulouse and Occitanie, Météo-France is predicting a drop in temperatures for Monday, August 18, 2025. According to the weather service, temperatures in Toulouse are expected to reach 33°C, a significant decrease from the almost record-breaking highs of the previous week. The sky is expected to be mostly cloudy, with a risk of thunderstorms in the evening. In other parts of Occitanie, temperatures are also expected to decrease, but the heat will still be felt in coastal cities, with temperatures reaching 38°C in Alès and Nîmes, and 35°C in Perpignan. Météo-France's forecast is as follows: 34°C in Cahors, 30°C in Laguiole, and 28°C in Saint-Gaudens. The sky will be mostly cloudy throughout the day, with a risk of thunderstorms in the evening and overnight.

title: Soleil ou pluie : quelle météo à Rouen et au Havre pour la dernière semaine d'août ?
content: The article provides a day‑by‑day weather forecast for the cities of Rouen and Le Havre during the last week of August 2025. Monday is expected to be sunny with temperatures around 20 °C in the morning, rising to 27 °C in the afternoon in both cities. Tuesday will bring rain to Le Havre and a cloudy sky to Rouen, with afternoon showers across the department and temperatures between 21 °C and 23 °C. Wednesday’s morning will see the rain stop but the sky remain overcast, with 20 °C; the afternoon will bring new showers to Le Havre while Rouen stays cloudy. Thursday will be rainy everywhere, with temperatures staying near 20 °C. Friday will continue to be cloudy and rainy all day, with a slight drop in temperatures. The weekend will be wet: Saturday and Sunday will both be rainy, with temperatures falling to about 18 °C, suggesting a damp return to school. The forecast is presented in a straightforward, factual tone without opinion or emotive language.

title: Les prévisions météorologiques du mardi 26 août 2025 à Niort et ses environs
content: On Tuesday 26 August 2025, Niort is forecast to have an average temperature of about 23 °C with predominantly cloudy skies and no severe weather. The forecast details a temperature rise from 16 °C at dawn to a high of 29 °C at 16:00, wind speeds ranging from 15 km/h at 6:00 to a maximum of 40 km/h in the late afternoon, with gusts up to 55 km/h. Wind direction is variable, shifting from northwest to south overnight. The following day, temperatures will be lower, averaging 20 °C with a maximum of 24 °C, still cloudy but with no precipitation expected. (Source: Ouest France, 26 August 2025).

title: Bilan météo d'août 2025 : vague de chaleur exceptionnelle au sud, entre sécheresse et records de pluie au nord - Actualités La Chaîne Météo
content: According to the La Chaîne Météo report, August 2025 was the 8th hottest August on record since 1900, with a thermal excess of +1.4 °C. It was also the 11th consecutive month and the 4th consecutive August in which temperatures exceeded normal levels. The maximum temperature recorded was +43.4 °C, observed on 11 August at Monpazier (Dordogne) and Argeliers (Aude). The lowest temperature noted was 2.5 °C on 25 August at Buhl‑Lorraine (Moselle). The greatest average temperature excess was +2.4 °C at Agen (Lot‑et‑Garonne). In terms of precipitation, the national average exceeded normal by +4 %. Monthly rainfall records were set in 24‑hour periods: 96 mm at Chartres (Eure‑et‑Loir) and 82.2 mm at Fontainebleau (Seine‑et‑Marne) on 20 August.

title: Météo. Quel temps fera-t-il à Toulouse et en Occitanie, lundi ? Voici les prévisions
content: On Monday, October 5, 2025, Toulouse and the broader Occitanie region are expected to experience a return of sunshine after a cool morning with temperatures reaching 9°C at sunrise. According to Météo France, the sky, initially overcast in the early morning, will clear rapidly. The afternoon will be pleasant and sunny, with minimal wind and peak temperatures of 19°C. The evening will remain clear. In Occitanie, the weather pattern will be consistent across the region—from Aveyron to the Pyrénées-Orientales—with sunny conditions and maximum temperatures ranging between 18°C and 22°C depending on the area.

title: Voici ce que la météo nous réserve pour les vacances de Toussaint : "La situation est assez bloquée, pour le moment..."
content: According to meteorological forecasts from DH.be, weather conditions in France and surrounding regions are currently stable and relatively dry, with light drizzle and persistent low-level humidity causing overcast skies and limited sunshine. The average temperature remains near seasonal norms of approximately 15°C, with no significant cold snaps expected before November 1. A slight weather shift is anticipated by late weekend or early next week, bringing a more disturbed pattern with a southwest oceanic airflow and modest precipitation. While the upcoming week will be slightly wetter and more dynamic, temperatures will remain moderate, staying close to seasonal averages with mild nights. Long-term outlooks for November, December, and January suggest a positive temperature anomaly of 0.5 to 1°C above average across Europe, indicating a generally mild winter. However, this does not rule out isolated cold spells or snow events, as average conditions can still include short-term extremes. The overall forecast is neither exceptionally good nor bad—weather will be mixed but not severe.

title: Nord et Pas-de-Calais. Profitez du soleil, la pluie et les orages arrivent !
content: The weather outlook for the Nord and Pas‑de‑Calais region from 25 to 31 August 2025 shows a mix of sunshine and rain, with temperatures ranging from 18 °C to 25 °C. Monday 25th: "Le soleil sera présent dès le matin" and the mercury will climb to 25 °C in the afternoon. Tuesday 26th: the sky will be veiled but warm, with temperatures above 20 °C and up to 25 °C, and "des averses annoncées sur tout le littoral, de Dunkerque à Berck". Wednesday 27th: very cloudy, 20‑25 °C during the day, but the evening will bring rain and the threat of thunderstorms, signalling the start of a long period of disturbances. Thursday 28th: the mercury will hover around 20 °C, with showers throughout the day and thunderstorms especially in the Avesnois. Friday 29th: "Pluie, pluie et pluie" with temperatures between 18 °C and 20 °C. Saturday 30th: similar to Friday, with showers all morning, afternoon and evening. Sunday 31st: rain will fall all day, keeping temperatures at 18‑20 °C, ending the holiday period on a somewhat gloomy note.

title: Un ciel assez dégagé mais des températures toujours fraîches : la météo de ce week-end en France
content: According to Météo France, the majority of France will not see temperatures above 20 °C even in the afternoon, despite clear skies. The weekend will be calm with no precipitation. Saturday morning: western France will be fairly cloudy, the Paris region very cloudy, and dense fog will surround Auxerre and Chaumont; southern areas such as Lyon, Nice and Marseille will see sunshine. Ajaccio in Corsica will reach 22 °C, the only region above 20 °C. In the afternoon, the west will clear but not fully bright; fog will lift; temperatures may exceed 20 °C in Bordeaux, Toulouse, Montpellier and Nice. Evening: light rain will fall in Brest, and the sky will be cloudy around Nantes, Limoges, Aurillac and Perpignan. Sunday will follow a similar pattern, with 20 °C in Ajaccio. Monday will remain calm and cool, with a few showers in Cherbourg. Tuesday will bring showers in the east. The forecast notes that "Le soleil sera au rendezvous" in the south and that "le brouillard se dissipera" in the west, underscoring the expected clear but cool conditions.
